summary: Goal2 passes the supplied source-bound development visual scope against approved Play and official instrument roles. The small score star aligns with earned text, exact score/target reflow keeps complete glyphs, and modest stronger forecast numbers remain subordinate to the star field. Hosted/narrow stress, normal default-phone, AX5 pressure/recovery, Sunny/Spark reader and actual AX5 Calm tablet states identify no current visual failure. All13 retained exports have exact raw/export fidelity review, with four tablet comparisons independently supplied by hud_goal_review. Prior width failures and label/source corrections remain explicit; mechanical results, motion and human/physical evidence are separate.
references: docs/design/GAME_UI_SYSTEM.md, goal 2 instrument roles and whole-screen visual criteria
